description: Fetch the x402 402-challenge payment requirements for a SIGNED intent WITHOUT paying: scheme, network (eip155:<chainId>), payTo, amount, asset, and the USDC EIP-712 domain (extra.name/version) the authorization must be signed with. Read-only (no X-PAYMENT is ever attached). NOTE: x402 is live on Base mainnet (8453) when X402_ENABLED=1; it is paused elsewhere (Robinhood 4663 is wallet-only in v1), where this tool errors instead of fetching.
name: acm_get_payment_requirements
